title: 第十六章 卡卡西的指导第十七章 抉择和贩卖为800推荐票
content_zh:
，，！
一小时后，王长乐总算是来到了中心区域。
一路走来，因王长乐隐藏面容的原因，所以并没什么人关注他。
他虽已经无父无母，也算得上是众叛亲离，孤家寡人一个，他的确也不怕什么牵连和报复。
但这里的所有契约者，都是来自于现实世界。
隐藏面容可以大幅度降低，他在现实生活中遭遇麻烦的几率。
毕竟他现在身上还背负着大仇，他并不希望有什么原因成为阻碍。
再有，他现在的战斗力并不算强，生命使徒职业并没有给他带来可观的属性收益，技能虽强，但一个攻击技能都没有。
没有应对的实力的时候，就需要先学会忍耐，只有忍耐的成功，才有发达起来的机会！
面向眼前恢弘高大的建筑，让人有一种说不出来的震撼、、、…除了这四座建筑物，其他的建筑都陷入了迷雾之中，看不到的原因，大概是他的权限太低。
王长乐确定方向，快步穿过人群，走进了。
刚过大门，王长乐眼前一花，空间转换。
须臾之间，他已身处仅仅几平米的钢铁单间之中。
四周传来‘哒哒’的机械声，一块弧形屏幕出现在他的面前。
交付乐园币后，屏幕上开始出现讯息力量：6敏捷：7体力：8智力：8魅力：8本来所有的契约者，都是可以自由选择亲和属性，从而可以做到有规划的发展。
但王长乐因为生命使徒的原因，他的亲和属性已经被固定了。
对于这种结果，王长乐也有所预料，毕竟生命使徒这个职业还是很强力。
况且这已经是既定的事实了，面对无法反抗的事实，那最好的方法，就是快速的去适应，然后做出改变，让结果有利于自己！
看着眼前显示出的提示信息，王长乐直接点选了体力和智力各+2体力加2点，是为了能够快速的穿上蓝色装备韧之甲。
智力加2点，他再怎么看都是一个法师，虽然攻击能力都没有！

但他的技能消耗都算比较大，智力能够强化效果，也能加强魔法值的上限，还是他的亲和属性。
“不使用”
强化属性时虽然伴随着巨大的痛苦，但是却能够正常的提升属性。
他在还是一个普通人的时候，就已经尝试过1星进化药剂了，现在他的体质比之前好，增加的属性还没有之前多，他没道理要害怕。
强化仓在“咔哒~咔哒”
的加速中，开始运行起来，一种剧烈的疼痛从身体的内部传来。
这是一种刻骨的痛，王长乐只觉身上的所有的肌肉都在融化，然后又在不断的重组拉伸，撕裂的痛处伴随着是肌肉的酸胀。
大脑更是发胀，血液似乎一下子就集中到了脑部，让他有一种急速充血的感觉，充血过速之后，是种颅内高压般的感觉，这种感觉让人痛不欲生，他疼的几次都想晕过去，但意识却又无比的清醒。
十分钟的时间，他感觉像被人连续捶打了10小时。
浑身大汗的他，在强化结束的时候，颇有一种劫后余生的感觉。
不过，现在他感觉得到身体更加结实了，原本还有些虚胖的身体，变得更加的紧实，他能清晰地感知到身体的每一块肌肉群。
智力的强化，则让他的精神感知力有了进一步的增长，他现在能清晰的感知到，周围五米的气息，如果有人靠近他都能提前感应。
感觉是痛苦的，但是效果却很是美好，这对于他而言就够了。
如果付出都有回报，那么一切都值得！
在强化完属性之后，王长乐的智力和体力都变成了10。
从衍生世界出来到来到轮回乐园，他已经很长时间没有进食了，属性强化的提升的同时，也带走了他身体大量的热量。

,,!
An hour later, Wang Changle finally arrived at the central area.
Along the way, because Wang Changle hid his face, no one paid attention to him.
Although he has no father or mother, he can be regarded as a deserted and lonely man. He is indeed not afraid of any involvement or revenge.
But all the contractors here come from the real world.
Hiding his face can greatly reduce the chance of him getting into trouble in real life.
After all, he still carries a big hatred on his body, and he doesn't want any reason to stand in the way.
Furthermore, his current combat effectiveness is not very strong. The Life Apostle profession does not bring him considerable attribute gains. Although his skills are strong, he does not have any attack skills.
When you don’t have the strength to deal with it, you need to learn to be patient first. Only with successful patience can you have the chance to develop!
Facing the majestic and tall buildings in front of us, people feel an indescribable shock... Except for these four buildings, the other buildings are all in the fog. The reason why they can't see it is probably because his authority is too low.
Wang Changle determined the direction, walked quickly through the crowd, and walked in.
Just after passing the gate, Wang Changle's eyes flashed, and the space changed.
In an instant, he was already in a single steel room of only a few square meters.
There was a mechanical sound of "click" from all around, and a curved screen appeared in front of him.
After delivering the paradise coins, a message began to appear on the screen. Strength: 6 Agility: 7 Physical strength: 8 Intelligence: 8 Charm: 8 Originally, all contractors were free to choose affinity attributes, so that they could develop in a planned way.
But because Wang Changle is a life apostle, his affinity attribute has been fixed.
Wang Changle also expected this result. After all, the life apostle profession is still very powerful.
Moreover, this is already an established fact. Faced with a fact that cannot be resisted, the best way is to quickly adapt and then make changes to make the results beneficial to you!
Looking at the prompt information displayed in front of him, Wang Changle directly clicked on physical strength and intelligence +2 points each, physical strength plus 2 points, in order to quickly put on the blue equipment Armor of Toughness.
Add 2 points of intelligence. No matter how you look at him, he is still a mage, even though he has no attack ability!
But the cost of his skills is relatively large. Intelligence can enhance the effect and the upper limit of magic value. It is also his affinity attribute.
"Do not use"
Although it is accompanied by great pain when strengthening the attributes, the attributes can be improved normally.
When he was still an ordinary person, he had already tried the 1-star evolution potion. Now his physique is better than before, and the increased attributes are not as much as before. There is no reason for him to be afraid.
The reinforced warehouse is "click~click"
During the acceleration, it started to run, and a severe pain came from the inside of the body.
This was a bone-deep pain. Wang Changle felt that all the muscles in his body were melting, and then they were constantly being reorganized and stretched. The tearing pain was accompanied by soreness and swelling of the muscles.
The brain was even more swollen, and the blood seemed to be concentrated in the brain all of a sudden, giving him a feeling of rapid congestion. After the rapid congestion, there was a feeling of intracranial high pressure. This feeling was so painful that he wanted to faint several times from the pain, but his consciousness was extremely clear.
For ten minutes, he felt like he had been beaten continuously for 10 hours.
He was sweating profusely, and when the strengthening was over, he felt like he was surviving a disaster.
However, now he feels that his body is stronger. His body, which was still a little puffy, has become firmer. He can clearly feel every muscle group in his body.
The strengthening of his intelligence has further increased his mental perception. He can now clearly sense the breath of the surrounding five meters, and he can sense in advance if someone approaches.
It feels painful, but the effect is wonderful, this is enough for him.
If your efforts are rewarded, then everything is worth it!
After strengthening his attributes, Wang Changle's intelligence and physical strength both became 10.
He has not eaten for a long time since he came out of the derivative world and came to the reincarnation paradise. The improvement in attribute strengthening also took away a lot of heat from his body.
